🛟 the person in their 50s stands up by the fire. "The sick can't wait us out. Somebody has to say it, so: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Triage tents and broth for the sick, or half rations till it passes, or the healthy hunt hard to keep everyone fed. Pick — everything costs."
"Or we rally," the person in their 50s adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
